name: Nayuta
source:
"That’s right, you don’t wanna go there! The Battleship is a bad, bad place! It’s much better here!"

Neo-fennec no. 888. Gluttonous, spontaneous, and foul-mouthed to a fault.
Seldevice of choice: Handy Chainsaw.

Fled Battleship Baobab to be a slum boss in the Red Zone. After Ichizo befriends her, she relocates to Lost Eden, though she has yet to mend her rough-and-tumble ways.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2051100]Steam[/url]]
